sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the existing IA Super and bulbousBowPresent=false applicability branch, exactly-one controlled iceClass and boolean checks, positive shipBreadth/shipLength/iceClassDraught checks, declared units, and absence of positivity constraints on coefficientF1–F4 and coefficientG1–G3. Repair applicability: the current single sh:or branch makes every targeted ship IA Super without a bulb and therefore rejects non-applicable ships; non-applicable ships must pass without the formula operand/result constraints, while missing branch-selection evidence must not pass.
